# Orientation Tasks 2

## Task 1

### a) Why does an arrival event need to generate a new arrival event?

Customers have 1 way in, which is an arrival event  and then it schedules the next event. On top of chaining the events so the que doesnt become empty, and nolonger take more events, it only hold one future arrival per customers source instead of schedulling a lot all at once. 

### b) Which event should be generated by the start of the service?

The start of service is a C-event. It is scheduled at the end of a B event, cus C-events are kinda dependant on whether or not its possible. and then ofcourse it schedules a B-event after that.
